meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Rahatani | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE coaching for Rahatani students at our nearby Wakad branch, by Rahatani Road and Jagtap Dairy. Faculty from Kota, batches of {{fact:batch.size}}.

intro: From Rahatani, our Wakad branch is about {{commute:rahatani#km}} km away, the nearer of our two centres.

body.text: Rahatani Road takes you to Jagtap Dairy, and from there the Jagtap Dairy to Wakad road leads to the branch.
Rainbow BRTS buses have run through Rahatani since November 2015.

sections.heading: Rahatani and its neighbours

body.text: Rahatani lies between Pimple Saudagar and Kalewadi, on the banks of the Pavana. All three are closest to our Wakad branch.

body: Because the trip is short, the time after class ends at {{fact:batch.timings#end}} is still a usable evening for homework.

body.text: Rahatani students choose between two years starting in Class 11 and one year in Class 12.
